# SilverLake Car Rentals

> Premium car hire in Kisumu, Kenya, with drivers or self-drive. Book instantly via M-Pesa or bank transfer.

SilverLake Car Rentals is based in Kisumu, Kenya and serves destinations across the country. The
fleet includes SUVs (e.g. Toyota Prado), family vehicles (Toyota Voxy, Axio) and vans, available
with a professional driver or for self-drive. Bookings require a deposit of at least 30% of the
total cost, paid via M-Pesa or bank transfer.

## Key Pages

- [Fleet](https://silverlakecarentals.com/fleet): Browse available vehicles, daily rates, and service types.
- [Book](https://silverlakecarentals.com/book): Start a booking.
- [FAQ](https://silverlakecarentals.com/faq): Deposit, cancellation, refund and required-document details.
- [Refund & Cancellation Policy](https://silverlakecarentals.com/refund-policy): Full terms.
- [Reviews](https://silverlakecarentals.com/reviews): Customer reviews and ratings.
- [Blog](https://silverlakecarentals.com/blog): Kisumu and Kenya travel guides.
- [Become a Driver](https://silverlakecarentals.com/become-a-driver): Apply as a driver-partner.
- [Contact](https://silverlakecarentals.com/contact): Phone, email and support.
